title: A covector vanishing on all strictly increasing standard-basis tuples is zero
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every n-covector α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n (a continuous alternating n-linear form on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)): if α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}) = 0 for every strictly increasing I : Fin n → Fin P, where (e_j)_{j ∈ Fin P} = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ is the standard orthonormal basis of ℝ^P, then α = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ I : Fin n → Fin P, StrictMono I → α (fun i => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (I i)) = 0) → α = 0
